name: W unit meets counit
summary: Plugging the W unit |0⟩ into the W counit ⟨0| gives the empty diagram.
description:
The W-spider (black triangle) with one input and $n$ outputs maps $|0\rangle \mapsto |0\cdots 0\rangle$ and $|1\rangle \mapsto |10\cdots0\rangle + |010\cdots0\rangle + \cdots + |0\cdots01\rangle$: it spreads a single excitation over its outputs in all possible ways. The small dot marks its input leg. A W-spider with no outputs is the state $|0\rangle$ (read as an effect, it is $\langle 0|$), which is the unit of the W-spider read as a 'merge'.

Connecting two W-spiders without outputs along their input legs is therefore the scalar $\langle 0|0\rangle = 1$, the empty diagram. This is one of the Hopf-algebra axioms of the W-spider (the counit of the unit is 1), axiom 5c of Hadzihasanovic's original complete ZW-calculus, where the unit is drawn as a binary black vertex on a black vertex with a loop.
notes: The right-hand side is the empty diagram.
